visualContinuity: Contemporary Tehran only; do not switch to a European, Mediterranean, fantasy, or mountain-village setting.
Use the Alborz Mountains as a distant northern backdrop when geography is visible.
Use Tehran-consistent streets, parks, apartment architecture, shops, buses, taxis, and urban furniture.
Milad Tower may appear only when a wide skyline view makes it geographically plausible; it must not jump position between adjacent scenes.
Keep time of day, weather, season, clothing, and travel direction continuous inside each chapter.

imageRules: All female characters are shown with hijab when outside the home or where the established design requires it.
Do not add a cat as a Nino substitute, clue, portrait, or reunion animal.
No readable text should be embedded in generated artwork.
Keep recurring props, backpacks, vehicles, storefronts, and landmarks stable across adjacent chapter images.
Use cinematic storybook realism with warm natural light, detailed Iranian environments, and child-friendly emotional expressions.
